level: Cultivation Technician I / entry occupational pathway
intendedAudience: Learners progressing through the THC Cultivation Technician I pathway
Entry-level cultivation employees developing supervised operational competency
evidencePolicy: Use canonical evidence-backed science and operational references for durable principles. Facility SOPs, product labels, equipment manuals, and jurisdiction-specific requirements control when they are more specific. Reused curriculum modules are development dependencies and do not substitute for course-specific occupational review.
assessmentPolicy: This draft course is not credential evidence merely because its structure exists. Course-specific formative work, a course-level summative assessment, accessibility review, human technical review, and any required practical evidence must be completed and validated before the course can advance beyond draft/review status.
title: Integrated Cultivation Technician Practice Lab
description: Provides the development container for an integrated Technician I shift simulation spanning safety, sanitation, observation, measurement, irrigation, crop care, harvest/postharvest handoff, traceability, equipment boundaries, records, and escalation. Current mapped modules are prerequisite refreshers; a dedicated lab module and credential practical/capstone evidence remain required before release.
learningOutcomes: Execute a multi-stage technician shift simulation while preserving safety, sanitation, identity, authorization boundaries, and record integrity.
Collect and interpret routine crop, environmental, water/root-zone, equipment, and traceability evidence without inventing unsupported causes.
Prioritize and escalate abnormal conditions according to consequence, authorization, supplied procedures, and unresolved uncertainty.
Produce an integrated work record and shift handoff that allows another qualified person to reconstruct what occurred and what remains open.
